text:
sam: ACME POC readiness thread. Goal: 3-day POC, show integration, cost baseline, and security checklist. Need owners for SSO/auth, SDK examples, quotas, streaming behavior, telemetry hooks, and pricing confirmation.

anya: I'll own SSO/auth + security questionnaire follow-up. We require signed NDA + completed SecQ v2.1. For SSO we support SAML2 and OIDC; can do Just-In-Time user provisioning for orgs. Need their IdP metadata and a security contact.

noah_acme: thanks. We can share IdP metadata by EOD. A couple questions: can you support IP allowlist for admin API access? And what logs are retained?

priya: yes on allowlist (org-level). Logs: request logs + audit trails retained 90 days on hosted by default; longer retention is an enterprise add-on. We also have a data-deletion API for PII removal. Need to know ACME retention policy.

devin: I'll own pricing and quotas. For the POC we usually provide $5k trial credit + metered overage. Suggested POC pricing: flat trial, then pay-as-you-go at $0.015 per 1k tokens for the selected model family. For acceptance, aim for cost under $0.018/1k tokens effective across runs. Any objections?

noah_acme: that pricing sounds OK. Can you also add a temporary usage cap so we don't accidentally spike?

devin: yes; we'll set soft cap alerts at 80% of trial credit and hard cap to stop calls at 120% if requested. For POC quotas set to 50 rps, 500k tokens/day to start.

sam: SDK/streaming owner? Need a small snippet for them showing streaming with cancel and safe retries. Also mention idempotency for non-streaming.

priya: I'll drop an example. Note: streaming cancels automatically if client disconnects. For reconnects we advise a resume token pattern for chat-like sessions; otherwise start a fresh conversation idempotently.

priya: SDK example (python):

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")

# streaming with cancel behavior
with client.stream("completion", model="small-v1") as stream:
    for part in stream:
        print(part.text)
# if client disconnects, server frees KV and stops tokens

# idempotent non-stream call
resp = client.generate(model="small-v1", input="Hello", idempotency_key="acme-req-01")
```

priya: curl example for retries + idempotency: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"small-v1","input":"...","idempotency_key":"acme-req-01"}'
```

anya: Security checklist items for ACME: NDA signed, SecQ v2.1, IdP metadata, list of expected IPs for allowlist, retention policy, and whether they need Private (VPC) or Hosted with KMS. If Private requested we need legal/ops lead and a timeline for infra access.

noah_acme: We'll provide NDA and SecQ. We prefer hosted with KMS for now. Retention is 180 days for logs.

sam: infra notes: recommend a small dedicated instance (1x A10 class) with burst enabled. Routing policy: primary -> dedicated pool, fallback -> quantized variant. If we hit quota, API returns 429 with Retry-After and we automatically redirect to fallback if configured.

ops_bot: INF ticket created INF-4601: provision dedicated pool for ACME POC. Assigned to infra oncall.

devin: acceptance criteria suggested by product team: 1) End-to-end P95 latency < 350ms for p50 input length, 2) Successful streaming stability across 1000 streams with <1% disconnects, 3) Cost per 1k tokens effective <= $0.018, 4) Eval accuracy: pass on 40/50 golden completions, 5) Security checklist complete.

priya: I'll build a simple eval harness that posts results to a shared S3 CSV and a tiny dashboard. Need ACME prompt set: 30 representative prompts + 50 gold outputs if available.

noah_acme: we'll upload prompts by 14:00. Also one more ask: can you show sample telemetry webhooks or event streams for per-request metrics?

sam: yes, we emit per-request telemetry via webhook or can push to a Prometheus endpoint for Dedicated. For webhooks we sign payloads with HMAC. Provide endpoint and we'll register it.

anya: compliance blurb I'll share: SOC2 Type II excerpts + encryption at-rest via KMS, TLS1.2+, RBAC for console, and audit logs. Will attach docs to the ticket.

devin: final note on retries: recommend client-side exponential backoff with jitter. Server-side best-effort dedupe via idempotency_id for 24 hours. Example policy: retries=4, base=200ms, cap=4s, jitter=true.

sam: timeline proposal: NDA + SecQ by 10:00, IdP metadata + prompts by 14:00, infra provision INF-4601 completed by 16:00, eval run 16:30-17:30, review + pricing check 18:00. Can owners ack?

anya: ack. I'll send SecQ and SOC2 excerpts.

priya: ack. SDK + telemetry examples will be uploaded to the drive link.

devin: ack. I'll set up billing/trial caps and notify finance.

noah_acme: ack from ACME side. We'll get the docs and prompts over. Thanks everyone.

sam: great, logging next steps in the POC ticket and will ping ACME when infra is ready. :thumbsup:
